features.name: Paseo · white lamp 1
features.trust: Nearest lamp in IMG_2352 (looking west) and top of IMG_2354; along-wall position estimated from the photos, about 1-2 m. Photographed standing on the stamped paseo itself, not on the wall or coping: each shaft rises from a small square base plate set on the pavement against the sandstone foot (IMG_2352, IMG_2350; the next lamp's base shows at the top of IMG_2354). Perspective read of IMG_2352 (camera about 1.55 m up, vanishing point of the wall foot and timber edge) puts the shaft centre about 0.15 m seaward of the wall foot on a paved width of about 2.9-3.0 m; shaft about 3.5 m plus a flat head about 0.65 m long reaching over the walk. The protected paseo route (data/paseo_wall.json route: 3 m wide, centre 1.5 m seaward of the face) covers the whole paving up to the wall face, so the shaft alone lies about 0.3 m inside the guard (centre about 1.35 m from the route centreline against 1.65 m needed at zero radius). The paseo therefore does not keep its full route clear beside a lamp, and the lamp is omitted by the shared guard rather than moved onto the coping or into the garden, where no photo puts it. Placeable only if the protected paseo width is reduced to the clear walk beside wall-foot fixtures (about 2.7 m), which is a route decision outside this task.
